{{Short description|European footballing award}} {{Use dmy dates|date=January 2023}} {{Infobox award | name = 2005 Ballon d'Or | subheader = | image = Ronaldinho 11feb2007.jpg | image_size = | alt = | caption = 2005 Ballon d’Or winner, Ronaldinho | awarded_for = | date = {{start date|2005|11|28|df=y}} | location = [[Paris]], France | country = France | presenter = ''[[France Football]]'' | host = | former name = | preshow_host = | acts = | website = {{URL|ballondor.com}} | runtime = | award1_type = Won by | award1_winner= {{flagicon|BRA}} [[Ronaldinho]] (1st award) | previous = [[2004 Ballon d'Or|2004]] | main = [[Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2006 Ballon d'Or|2006]] }} The '''2005 Ballon d'Or''' ({{lit|'''2005 Golden Ball'''}}), given to the best [[Association football|football]] player in Europe as judged by a panel of sports journalists from [[UEFA]] member countries, was delivered to the Brazilian [[Attacking midfielder|Attacking Midfielder]] [[Ronaldinho]] on 28 November 2005.{{cite web |last= BBC Sport staff |url= http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/4475808.stm |title= Ronaldinho scoops European award |work= [[BBC Sport]] |date= 28 November 2005 |access-date= 10 January 2014 |archive-date= 30 November 2017 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20171130163834/http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/football/4475808.stm |url-status= live }} Ronaldinho was the third Brazilian to win the award after [[Rivaldo]] ([[1999 Ballon d'Or|1999]]) and [[Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)|Ronaldo]]. [[Paolo Maldini]] (Italy) was the best ranked [[Defender (association football)|defender]], at sixth, while [[Thierry Henry]] (France) was the top-ranked [[Forward (association football)|forward]], at fourth place. ==Rankings== On 24 October 2005, was announced the shortlist of 50 male players compiled by a group of experts from ''[[France Football]]''.{{cite news |last= Record staff |url= http://www.record.xl.pt/arquivo/interior.aspx?content_id=251207 |title= Deco, Figo e Ronaldo candidatos à Bola de Ouro 2005 |trans-title= Deco, Figo and Ronaldo nominated for 2005 Golden Ball |language= pt |date= 24 October 2005 |work= [[Record (Portuguese newspaper)|Record]] |access-date= 10 January 2014 |archive-date= 10 January 2014 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20140110152910/http://www.record.xl.pt/arquivo/interior.aspx?content_id=251207 |url-status= live }} There were 52 voters, from Albania, Andorra, Armenia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, England, Estonia, Faroe Islands, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Israel, Italy, Kazakhstan, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macedonia, Malta, Moldova, the Netherlands, Northern Ireland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Republic of Ireland, Romania, Russia, San Marino, Scotland, Serbia and Montenegro, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine and Wales. Each picked a first (5pts), second (4pts), third (3pts), fourth (2pts) and fifth choice (1pt).{{cite web | last = Pierrend | first = José | url = https://www.rsssf.org/miscellaneous/europa-poy05.html | title = European Footballer of the Year ("the best 2005 | date = 29 January 2006 | work = [[RSSSF]] | access-date = 26 December 2008 | archive-date = 11 May 2011 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20110511111548/http://www.rsssf.com/miscellaneous/europa-poy05.html | url-status = live }}{{Cite web |title=France Football |url=http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/MAG_BALLON_RONNIE.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051130035544/http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/MAG_BALLON_RONNIE.html |archive-date=2005-11-30 |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=www.francefootball.fr}}{{Cite web |title=France Football |url=http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/JOURNAL_BALLONDOR.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061125004610/http://www.francefootball.fr/FF/JOURNAL_BALLONDOR.html |archive-date=2006-11-25 |access-date=2025-12-19 |website=www.francefootball.fr}} ===Voted players=== {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 90%; text-align: center;" |- ! rowspan="2" style="width:33px;"| Rank ! rowspan="2" style="width:125px;"| Player ! rowspan="2" style="width:125px;"| Nationality ! rowspan="2" style="width:225px;"| Club(s) ! rowspan="2" | Total ! colspan="5" | Votes by place ! rowspan="2" style="width:33px;"| Votes |- ! style="width:33px;"| 1st ! style="width:33px;"| 2nd ! style="width:33px;"| 3rd ! style="width:33px;"| 4th ! style="width:33px;"| 5th |- style="background-color: #FFF68F; font-weight: bold;" |1st |align="left"|[[Ronaldinho]] |align="left"|{{flag|Brazil}} |align="left"|{{fbaicon|ESP}} [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] |225 |33 |11 |4 |2 | -
